info.title: xantham
info.description: Command line driver for the Xantham TypeScript-to-F# bindings generator.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: TypeScript declarations to F# Fable bindings

commands.name: init
commands.description: install the xantham typescript compiler dependencies

commands.name: version
commands.description: show the xantham typescript compiler version

commands.name: generate
commands.description: generate a binding and its manifest

options.name: --out
options.description: where the binding, the shipped groups, manifest.json and symbols.jsonl are written. [default: xantham-out]

options.name: --config
options.description: the xantham.json configuring the run, or the directory holding one (default: the package directory).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: write the file list alone, dropping the findings summary. [default: False]

arguments.name: PACKAGE_DIR
arguments.description: a directory holding package.json and the node_modules its declarations resolve through.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: write the JSON Schema for xantham.json
